equation.label: Vertical trace
equation.formula: $$f\left( {a,y} \right) = z$$ for $$x = a$$ or $$f\left( {x,b} \right) = z$$ for $$y = b$$

equation.label: Level surface of a function of three variables
Differentiability (two variables)
equation.formula: $$f\left( {x,y} \right) = f\left( {x_{0},y_{0}} \right) + f_{x}\left( {x_{0},y_{0}} \right)\left( {x - x_{0}} \right) + f_{y}\left( {x_{0},y_{0}} \right)\left( {y - y_{0}} \right) + E\left( {x,y} \right),$$ where the error term $$E$$ satisfies $$\underset{{({x,y})}\rightarrow{({x_{0},y_{0}})}}{\text{lim}}\frac{E\left( {x,y} \right)}{\sqrt{\left( {x - x_{0}} \right)^{2} + \left( {y - y_{0}} \right)^{2}}} = 0.$$

equation.label: Differentiability (three variables)
equation.formula: $$\begin{array}{cl} {f\left( {x,y} \right)} & {= f\left( {x_{0},y_{0},z_{0}} \right) + f_{x}\left( {x_{0},y_{0},z_{0}} \right)\left( {x - x_{0}} \right) + f_{y}\left( {x_{0},y_{0},z_{0}} \right)\left( {y - y_{0}} \right)} \\ & {\mspace{9mu} + f_{z}\left( {x_{0},y_{0},z_{0}} \right)\left( {z - z_{0}} \right) + E\left( {x,y,z} \right),} \end{array}$$ where the error term $$E$$ satisfies $$\underset{{({x,y,z})}\rightarrow{({x_{0},y_{0},z_{0}})}}{\text{lim}}\frac{E\left( {x,y,z} \right)}{\sqrt{\left( {x - x_{0}} \right)^{2} + \left( {y - y_{0}} \right)^{2} + \left( {z - z_{0}} \right)^{2}}} = 0.$$

equation.label: Chain rule, two independent variables
equation.formula: $$\frac{dz}{du} = \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\frac{\partial x}{\partial u} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\frac{\partial x}{\partial u}$$ $$\frac{dz}{dv} = \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\frac{\partial x}{\partial v} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\frac{\partial y}{\partial v}$$

equation.label: Generalized chain rule
equation.formula: $$\frac{\partial w}{\partial t_{j}} = \frac{\partial w}{\partial x_{1}}\ \frac{\partial x_{1}}{\partial t_{j}} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial x_{2}}\ \frac{\partial x_{1}}{\partial t_{j}} + \text{⋯} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial x_{m}}\ \frac{\partial x_{m}}{\partial t_{j}}$$

equation.label: directional derivative (two dimensions)
equation.formula: $$D_{\mathbf{u}}f\left( {a,b} \right) = \underset{h\rightarrow 0}{\text{lim}}\frac{f\left( {a + h\ \text{cos}\ \theta,b + h\ \text{sin}\ \theta} \right) - f\left( {a,b} \right)}{h}$$ or $$D_{\mathbf{u}}f\left( {x,y} \right) = f_{x}\left( {x,y} \right)\text{cos}\ \theta + f_{y}\left( {x,y} \right)\text{sin}\ \theta$$
